name: CreateOS Builder
tagline: From a one-line idea to a running, paid app on CreateOS, with every step proven in a sandbox.
description: Give it a one-line app idea and it builds the app with you inside Claude or ChatGPT: it writes the spec and the stack, scaffolds the project, writes the code and its tests, adds Stripe Checkout with a verified webhook, and ends with a live preview URL and a CreateOS deploy checklist. Unlike a plain chat, it runs your code: every step happens in an isolated CreateOS sandbox (Node 24, Python 3.13), it reads the real errors and fixes them, and the checklist of each step is proven by real execution (install, tests, webhook signature tests, health check) before it moves on. Nothing runs on your machine and your keys never enter the sandbox. Best for small APIs and services that take a payment: waitlists, reservations, paid links, webhooks. It does not deploy for you or handle live payments: you get the commands and settings to deploy on CreateOS with your own account, in Stripe test mode.

tools.name: sandbox_run
tools.description: Runs a command in this session's CreateOS sandbox (devbox:1: Ubuntu 24.04, Node 24, Python 3.13, Bun, Go, Rust; project in /workspace/app), optionally uploading files first. Egress only to registry.npmjs.org, pypi.org, *.pythonhosted.org, github.com and *.githubusercontent.com. Input: { session_id, command, args?, files?: [{ path, content }] (paths under /workspace), timeout_ms? (max 300000; 120000 during the free trial), background? (true starts a long-running process such as a server and returns at once with its process id and log path) }. Output: stdout, stderr, exit_code, exec_ms and truncated. Use bash -lc for cd, && and pipes. Never run user code anywhere else.

tools.name: sandbox_preview
tools.description: Opens public ingress for a port of this session's sandbox, waits until the port answers and returns the preview URL. The server must listen on 0.0.0.0. The URL is temporary: it stops when the sandbox pauses or is destroyed. Input: { session_id, port }.

tools.name: sandbox_checkpoint
tools.description: Saves the current state of this session's sandbox (files, installed dependencies) before a risky change and returns a checkpoint id. Input: { session_id }.

tools.name: sandbox_restore
tools.description: Brings this session's sandbox back to a checkpoint taken with sandbox_checkpoint, discarding the changes made after it. Use it when a fix made the tests worse. Input: { session_id, checkpoint_id }.

beforeAfter.prompt: Build me a waitlist API where people pay US$ 5 to reserve a spot.
beforeAfter.withoutSolver: Pastes an Express file with a /waitlist route and a Stripe snippet, says 'this should work', and leaves you to install, run and debug it on your machine.
beforeAfter.withSolver: Confirms a 4-behavior spec, scaffolds it in a CreateOS sandbox (npm install exit 0), writes code and tests and fixes the two real failures it hits, adds Checkout for 500 cents with a signature-verified webhook (5 webhook tests pass), starts the server and hands you a live preview URL plus a filled CreateOS deploy checklist.

beforeAfter.prompt: My Stripe webhook says 'No signatures found matching the expected signature'.
beforeAfter.withoutSolver: Suggests checking the secret and re-copying it from the dashboard.
beforeAfter.withSolver: Reproduces it in the sandbox with a locally signed payload, shows the cause (express.json() registered before the webhook route), moves the route to express.raw, and proves the fix with a passing signature test and a failing one for a wrong secret.

beforeAfter.prompt: I need a tiny URL shortener with a health check I can deploy today.
beforeAfter.withoutSolver: Writes the code and tells you to run npm start and open localhost.
beforeAfter.withSolver: Builds it in the sandbox with tests for create, redirect and 404, proves /health with curl, opens a preview URL, and gives the CreateOS settings: Node.js, port 3000, npm ci, npm start.
